title: Add private beta workflow dispatch helper
summary: Add a GitHub Actions workflow dispatch helper for the private beta lane with dry-run command-shape validation.
reason: After local and GitHub setup preflights pass, operators need one repeatable command to dispatch the private beta workflow with publish_release=false for the first CI-built artifact.
behavior_before: Operators had to manually construct the gh workflow run command after setup preflight passed.
behavior_after: Operators can dry-run or dispatch the private beta workflow through one script that validates input shape and calls the GitHub setup preflight before any real dispatch.
manual_validation: Invoke-PrivateBetaWorkflowDispatch.ps1 -DryRun - passed and produced publish_release=false gh workflow run command
git diff --check targeted workflow dispatch files - passed
pytest private beta dispatch/setup/workflow dry-run tooling suite - passed (7 passed)
refresh_summaries targeted workflow dispatch helper paths - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the dispatch helper script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This helper must not publish stable or release assets by default. The first beta dispatch defaults publish_release=false.
